tests.test_name: owner autosave persists bounded incomplete text and refuses cross-account writes
tests.keep_because: Another account cannot overwrite a private draft; a rejected write leaves the stored draft intact.

tests.test_name: COMPLETE_PAIR_REQUIRED: a half, blank, duplicated or unverifiable pair is refused before a write
tests.keep_because: Incomplete, swapped, mismatched or invalid authentication evidence is refused without changing account evidence.

tests.test_name: CSRF is required for both session creation and deletion
tests.keep_because: A cross-site request cannot create or delete the browser session without CSRF protection.

tests.test_name: EXACT_AMOUNTS_AND_PRICES: only exact eighteen-decimal amounts and positive prices review
tests.keep_because: Malformed, nonpositive or over-precision amounts/prices cannot enter a bid review, and a long amount is read exactly, never rounded.

tests.test_name: exact maximum is floored to the pinned zero-based grid without decimal rounding
tests.keep_because: Tick alignment never rounds a bid above the requested maximum; encoded calldata carries the aligned integer.

tests.test_name: tick boundaries, clearing floor, cap and huge precision use exact integer bounds
tests.keep_because: Price floors, caps, tick boundaries and integer overflow are enforced without floating-point arithmetic.

tests.test_name: BOUND_REGENT_CURRENCY: an auction raising anything else can neither be read nor bid on
tests.keep_because: A bid cannot silently spend a currency other than the configured REGENT currency.

tests.test_name: ACTIVE_WALLET_IS_THE_SIGNER: an unlinked wallet exposes nothing and prepares nothing
tests.keep_because: An unlinked wallet cannot expose a private bid position or prepare a bid.

tests.test_name: TREASURY_DRIFT_ENDS_EVERY_NEW_REVIEW
tests.keep_because: A treasury whose security changed since it was verified gets no new bid review.

tests.test_name: a verified local launch and bid project once under exact deterministic identities
tests.keep_because: Processing the same verified local launch/bid twice does not create duplicate records. This checks duplicate rows, not every possible replay effect.

tests.test_name: a later invalid resource refuses and rolls the whole launch projection back
tests.keep_because: A failed multi-record launch projection rolls back instead of leaving partial financial records.

tests.test_name: hands the wallet the exact reviewed bytes from the reviewed signer and reports the hash once
tests.keep_because: A press sends exactly the step the server built, from the reviewed signer and for its chain, and reports its hash once against its own review.

tests.test_name: two presses in a row both reach the wallet while the first is still there
tests.keep_because: Two presses in a row both reach the wallet; nothing blocks, queues or merges a repeat press.

tests.test_name: sends through the active wallet when it answers for another account, alone or in a batch
tests.keep_because: Founder's ruling, 17 Nov 2026: every press reaches Privy's active wallet, and the page never compares the wallet's account with the step's signer. A wallet answering for another account still gets the step as built, from the signer, alone or in a batch. It fails if such a press sends nothing.

tests.test_name: asks on every press off the step's network, and sends once the switch resolves
tests.keep_because: Founder's ruling, 17 Nov 2026: a wallet on another network is asked to switch through Privy's own switch on every press, and the same press sends once the switch resolves, alone or in a batch, with no read of the chain after it to refuse the press. It fails if a press is refused after the switch resolves.

tests.test_name: sends nothing when the switch is declined or fails, and the next press asks again and sends
tests.keep_because: A switch the person declines (4001, however the wallet wraps it) or that fails any other way sends nothing and is reported as switch_declined or network_mismatch, alone or in a batch; the next press asks the switch again and sends once it resolves.

tests.test_name: reports a declined request and a step the review does not have
tests.keep_because: A declined request and a step the review lacks are reported, with nothing else sent.

tests.test_name: LONG_STORED_PRICE: a bid estimate reads the whole stored price, never zero, and states it so a bid at it reaches it
tests.keep_because: A stored clearing price longer than 34 digits is read whole, so a bid below it is never estimated as buying now (live finding, 13 Oct 2026).

tests.test_name: HTML pages reject JSON selected by Accept or _format
tests.keep_because: JSON-selected HTML pages must return406 instead of crashing while encoding a LiveView safe-HTML tuple.

tests.test_name: a browser or an Accept header with an HTML fallback still gets LiveView HTML
tests.keep_because: Correcting JSON admission must keep HTML rendering and mixed Accept fallback working.

tests.test_name: the existing session fetch still returns JSON
tests.keep_because: JSON page rejection must preserve the existing wildcard and explicit-JSON session response.

tests.test_name: JSON account-link requests retain CSRF protection
tests.keep_because: X linking must admit its existing JSON format while continuing to reject requests without CSRF proof.

tests.test_name: SIGN_IN_ENDS_30_DAYS_AFTER_IT_WAS_MADE: a refresh never extends a sign-in
tests.keep_because: A sign-in ends 30 days after the bind that made it, however recently it was refreshed (Sean, 15 Oct 2026, decision 2a). A manual check cannot wait 30 days; the case fails if the bind stops recording the sign-in, if a refresh moves it, or if the end is counted from the last refresh again.

tests.test_name: LONG_POOL_PRICES_ARE_CUT_NOT_PARSED
tests.keep_because: Real pool prices run past Decimal's 34-digit parsing limit and may end in an ellipsis; parsing one crashed every token page with a pool price in review (Sentinel, 16 Oct 2026), and short test prices miss it. The case fails if copied details parse a price again or cut it differently from the page.

tests.test_name: hands wallet_sendCalls exactly the reviewed calls, atomically, after the chain read
tests.keep_because: BATCH_SENDS_ONLY_THE_REVIEW_ATOMICALLY: one Claim rewards press sends settle, every collect and claimAll together; the wallet must get exactly the server's calls, in order, from the reviewed signer, with atomicity required and the chain read last. A lab without a batching wallet cannot show this.

tests.test_name: sends nothing when the wallet cannot send the calls atomically, and says so
tests.keep_because: BATCH_SENDS_ONLY_THE_REVIEW_ATOMICALLY: a wallet that cannot send the calls atomically must send none of them, and the page must go back to one step at a time, where each press shows what it sends.

tests.test_name: BATCH_IS_THE_REVIEWS_ONLY_WITH_EVERY_CALL
tests.keep_because: A batch's transaction goes to the sender's own address or the entry point, never to the reviewed contract, so the usual target and calldata check cannot apply. A transaction is the review's only when it carries every reviewed call in order for the reviewed signer, and a smart account's ran only when the canonical EntryPoint itself records success; the page says Claimed only when the receipt also holds the launch splitter's own Claimed record for the signer, and otherwise that nothing was waiting. The case fails if a log from another contract is accepted as the entry point's, or a successful transaction without the claim record is called Claimed. No lab wallet sends batches, so manual review cannot reach this.

tests.test_name: ACCOUNT_SHOWS_A_PAIRED_AGENT
tests.keep_because: The Agents page builds each paired agent's row for the shared agents list, and a row missing a field the list reads crashed the page for everyone with a paired agent (v140, 16 Oct 2026, then on /account). A signed-out or unpaired review never sees it. The case fails if /account/agents stops mounting with a paired agent or stops showing its name and kind.

tests.test_name: a draft refuses hidden characters in a field, and a website must be a full link to launch
tests.keep_because: A null byte in a draft field reached the database and failed the save with no field marked, and a website that was not a link passed launch review and would be written into the token (found 17 Oct 2026). The case fails if a hidden character is saved instead of marked on its field, if a description loses its line breaks, or if a non-link website counts as complete.

tests.test_name: MARKET_PAGE_OTHER_FAILURE_IS_A_500: a read that fails another way is the plain error page
tests.keep_because: A market page whose auction read fails for any reason but a lost connection (here a missing table, 42P01) answers the plain 500 page, never the 503 Try again page or a 404, and the log names only the kind and module (market page read failed: Ash.Error.Unknown.UnknownError), none of the database's text. It fails while every failed read answers 503.

tests.test_name: an address that cannot name an auction is the not-found page
tests.keep_because: v146 answered an address that cannot name any auction (a tail that is not hex) with the 503 Try again page instead of not found (found live 17 Oct 2026). The case fails if such an address stops answering 404.

tests.test_name: WALLET_VIDEO_ONLY_FOR_ITS_OWNER: anyone else finds nothing at the address
tests.keep_because: A wallet's share video shows its bids, trades, stake and earnings, so only the signed-in account that links the wallet may fetch it, at the token's address and at the auction's (share video, 18 Oct 2026). Signed out or signed in as another account, both addresses are not found; the owner reaches the video, whose chain read failing says so (502) rather than not found. A manual check sees only the owner's own view. The case fails if either wallet check is dropped or loosened.

tests.test_name: share video cap holds under concurrent requests
tests.keep_because: Share videos asked for by many people at once, and by one person from several tabs at once, still hold the site to 1000 videos in 24 hours, each video is queued once however many ask for it together, and a person's tabs all get the same answer (1000-a-day cap, 18 Oct 2026). The asks run in their own processes and commit on their own connections, which no manual check can time. It fails if either part is undone: with the cap's lock removed it failed 3 of 3 runs (two videos made with room for one), and with a queued video no longer let through at the cap, 3 of 3 (one tab told the day's videos were all made while its video was queued).

tests.test_name: SHARE_VIDEO_OUTAGE_ONLY_FOR_A_LOST_CONNECTION: a lost database connection is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: The site's try-again page (503) is only for a database that cannot be reached (Sentinel pre-read, 18 Oct 2026). The case cuts its own database connection from a second connection part-way through a share-video request, which no manual check can time, and the request must answer 503. It fails if a lost connection is classed as any other failure (proven by switching the check off: 500 instead of 503).

tests.test_name: a video that couldn't be made answers with its own line, not the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A video whose render failed answers 500 with its own plain line, which the share window shows, instead of the outage page (Sentinel pre-read, 18 Oct 2026). Before this change every share-video failure raised the 503 outage page.

tests.test_name: a connection lost before the request reads the video's queue is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A database connection lost before the share-video request reads the video's queue answers the 503 try-again page, not a 500 (Sentinel verdict on 6fb2be2, 18 Oct 2026). The case cuts its own connection as that read starts, which no manual check can time. It fails if a lost connection on a read is classed as any other failure (proven by switching that off: 500).

tests.test_name: a connection lost while counting a queued video's place in line is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A database connection lost while counting a queued video's place in line answers 503 (Sentinel verdict on 6fb2be2, 18 Oct 2026). Ash raises the database's own exception from a count, which answered 500 at 6fb2be2; the case failed there and passes now.

tests.test_name: a database error that is not a lost connection answers with its own line
tests.keep_because: A real database error that is not a lost connection (42P01, the table renamed inside the case's transaction) answers 500 with its own plain line, not the 503 try-again page (Sentinel verdict on 6fb2be2, 18 Oct 2026). It fails if the list of connection codes is widened to take in other database errors (proven by widening it: 503). Its log line names only the error's module as Ash hands it over, with neither the table nor the code read from the message.

tests.test_name: every lost-connection code the database reports answers the try-again page
tests.keep_because: Every connection-exception code (class 08) and every server shutdown or start code (57P01 to 57P03), raised by the database itself on the share-video write, answers the 503 try-again page (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the fixed banner list is switched off or narrowed.

tests.test_name: a database code next to a lost connection's answers with its own line
tests.keep_because: Database codes beside the lost-connection ones (57P04, 57P05, 57014, 0A000), and a message that is a whole lost-connection banner ("** (Postgrex.Error) FATAL 57P01 (admin_shutdown) terminating connection"), answer 500 with their own line, not the try-again page (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the banner list is widened. It also fails if the anchored check becomes a contains check.

tests.test_name: a connection that waits too long for the database is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A share-video read dropped from the connection queue (DBConnection.ConnectionError, a real queue timeout) answers 503 (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the banner check is switched off or loses the DBConnection.ConnectionError banner.

tests.test_name: no word of a database error's message reaches the log
tests.keep_because: A database error whose message holds a value (a trigger raising "alice 0xab1") leaves none of it in any log line at any level, the database layer's own query lines included (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the log line carries the error's text.

tests.test_name: a connection that waits too long to count a queued video's place in line is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A queued video's place-in-line count dropped from the connection queue raises the connection's own DBConnection.ConnectionError, unwrapped by Ash, and answers 503 (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:35Z). It is the only real path to the raw DBConnection.ConnectionError clause and fails when that clause is off.

tests.test_name: a person's video is kept until three hours have passed, then made again
tests.keep_because: A person's made share video is stored and served as made for three hours, a new one is made after that with the old one kept, and once the site has made all of the day's videos a person keeps their saved video while one with none is told so (stored videos, 18 Oct 2026). Checking it by hand means waiting three hours and filling the day's 1000 videos.

tests.test_name: SAVED_VIDEO_GOES_AFTER_A_DAY_REQUEST_STAYS: a day-old video is deleted and its request kept
tests.keep_because: Sean chose "Saved videos only" (19 Oct 2026): the daily sweep deletes a saved video's bytes once it is a day old and keeps the request row. The case fails if the sweep deletes rows or keeps day-old videos.

tests.test_name: once saved videos are full, a video is still made, handed over once and never saved
tests.keep_because: Once the saved share videos reach their space (5 GB on the site), a new video is still made and handed over once, then let go; no video is ever deleted early (Sean, 19 Oct 2026). Filling 5 GB by hand is not practical. It fails if a video made past the space were kept after it was handed over (proven by serving it as a saved one: its bytes stayed).

tests.test_name: SAVED_VIDEOS_CAP_IS_5_GB: the site saves made videos only up to 5 GB
tests.keep_because: Sean: "Breaking the 5GB cap is not good, I dont want that database bill" (19 Oct 2026). The case reads the config the site ships with and fails if the saved-video ceiling there moves from 5 GB.

tests.test_name: a video made but not yet handed over counts toward the saved space
tests.keep_because: The 5 GB space count must include videos made but not yet handed over, or the cap can be passed. The case fails if the count leaves unsaved videos out.

tests.test_name: RENDER_HONOURS_SAVED_SPACE: a video made past the line is served but not saved
tests.keep_because: A share video rendered while the saved videos hold just under the saved space is saved; one rendered at or past it is still made and handed over once, but not saved (Sentinel's ask before v154, 19 Oct 2026). The real render runs from a queued request on a stored running auction, with only the chain node, ffmpeg and the space stood in, which filling 5 GB by hand cannot match. It fails if the render ignores the space check (saved always true) or ignores the configured space (the 5 GB constant put back): both mutations failed it.

tests.test_name: HEALTH_NAMES_THE_COMMIT: a ready site answers ok with its build's commit
tests.keep_because: The release checklist requires the health endpoint to name the deployed commit; v153's /healthz answered only "ok" (Sentinel, 19 Oct 2026). The case fails if a ready site stops naming its build's commit.

tests.test_name: PICTURE_HEADERS: a stored picture and its sized copy say a page from them may do nothing
tests.keep_because: Both picture answers carry the strict content policy, DENY framing, no-referrer and nosniff, as the site's other files do (Sentinel hold on f23984b2, 19 Oct 2026). It fails if either answer loses one.

tests.test_name: PIXEL_CAP: a 40,000 by 40,000 interlaced PNG under 2 MB is refused from its header, never decoded
tests.keep_because: An upload decoding to more than 4096 by 4096 pixels is refused from its header before libvips or zlib touches it; a 2 MB interlaced PNG otherwise decodes to 1.6 GB (Sentinel hold on f23984b2, 19 Oct 2026). Without the cap the same file is accepted after an 18-second full decode.

tests.test_name: PIXEL_CAP: JPEG and WebP headers are capped the same way, a moving WebP counting every frame
tests.keep_because: The cap reads the JPEG frame header and the WebP VP8, VP8L and VP8X headers, counts every frame of a moving WebP, and is not fooled by a one-pixel canvas holding a larger picture. It fails if any format skips the header check.

tests.test_name: a normal picture still passes, decoded in full
tests.keep_because: The cap refuses nothing an ordinary picture needs: the 480 by 720 JPEG and the PNG fixtures pass, fully decoded. It also shows the call record sees a decode, so the never-decoded cases are not vacuous.

tests.test_name: RESIZE_ONE_AT_A_TIME: two copies asked for at once are made one after the other
tests.keep_because: A sized copy decodes the whole original, so Autolaunch.StoredImage.Resizer makes one at a time (Sentinel hold on f23984b2, 19 Oct 2026). With both requests queued, the second decode starts only after the first returns; it fails if copies are made side by side.

tests.test_name: RESIZE_SKIPS_A_CALLER_THAT_GAVE_UP: a request past its caller's deadline is not made
tests.keep_because: A request carries the moment its caller stops waiting, and one whose turn comes after that makes no decode (lead decision, 19 Oct 2026). It fails if the resizer decodes for a caller that has given up.

tests.test_name: PICTURE_MISSES: each miss on a sized picture's address is refused and never reaches the resizer
tests.keep_because: A width pages never ask for, a type other than WebP, an unknown id or another digest answers 404 and a step up (..) is refused, all without reaching the one resizer (Sentinel hold on f23984b2, 19 Oct 2026). A control hit shows the call record sees the resizer.

tests.test_name: MARKET_PAGE_OUTAGE_ONLY_FOR_A_LOST_CONNECTION: a lost connection is a 503 with Try again
tests.keep_because: Cutting the case's database connection as the auction read starts answers the 503 Try again page, logged as market page read connection_lost with the error's module only. It is the one failure that may answer 503.

tests.test_name: a token page whose token cannot be read is the plain error page, not a 404 or a 503
tests.keep_because: The second read a token page makes, the token its auction launched, follows the same rule: a failure other than a lost connection answers the plain 500 page and the log carries none of the database's text. It fails while that read answers 503.

tests.test_name: PUBLIC_API_FAILED_READS_ARE_LOGGED: each failed read is logged by kind and module only
tests.keep_because: The public API's auction list and detail, bid quote, token list and detail and treasury report answered a failed read with internal_error and logged nothing. Each now logs the read, its kind and the error's module (or the quote's reason), with none of the database's text. It fails while any of them stays quiet.

tests.test_name: OLD_LINK_FAILED_READ_IS_NOT_A_MISSING_PAGE: a read that fails is a 500, never a 404
tests.keep_because: An old auction, share picture or token link whose read failed answered the site's 404, telling people and search engines the page was gone. It now answers the plain 500 page, logged as old link read failed with the error's module only; a link to nothing is still 404 and a working one still moves. It fails while a failed read answers 404.

tests.test_name: an old link that loses the database connection is a 503 with Try again
tests.keep_because: A cut database connection during an old link's read answers the 503 Try again page, as a market page does. It fails while a lost connection answers 404.

tests.test_name: STOCK_LIST_UNREAD_SAYS_SO: a stock list that can't be read says so, with Try again
tests.keep_because: A stock list the database could not give crashed /create into the site's Something went wrong page. The page now opens and says the stock list couldn't be read right now, with Try again, logged as stock list read failed with the error's module only; Try again shows the gallery once the list reads. It fails while a failed read crashes the page.

tests.test_name: SHARE_PICTURE_LEFT: an auction's words and price line stay where X shows them
tests.keep_because: X's phone view keeps only the left 660 or so of a share picture's 1200 pixels and lays the site's name over its bottom-left corner, so the auction picture's figures, hung from the right, and its autolaunch.sh band were hidden there (Design and Animation's ask, 20 Oct 2026). The picture is drawn for real from a stored auction with a long name, a 16-letter ticker, figures in REGENT and a price line, and nothing bright may sit right of x 660 or in that corner. It fails with the figures put back on the right, the price line pushed into the corner, or the site's name put back in the corner: all three mutations failed it.

tests.test_name: SHARE_PICTURE_LEFT: a token's words stay where X shows them
tests.keep_because: The token picture shares the auction picture's layout without the price line, so its strip sits lower; the same check that nothing bright sits right of x 660 or in X's bottom-left corner holds it there. It fails with the figures put back on the right or the site's name put back in the corner.

tests.test_name: SHARE_HOME_PICTURE: the home picture leaves X's title band clear
tests.keep_because: X lays the page title over the bottom-left of the autolaunch.sh share picture, so a word drawn there is covered in every post (Sean's share card review, 28 Oct 2026). The check reads the committed picture: its words must be bright in the left column and nothing bright may sit in the band X covers. Drawing the site's name into that band failed it.

tests.test_name: RELEASE_BOOT_READS_NO_DESCRIPTION: the migration boot on the serving app reads no deployment description and takes the release login
tests.keep_because: The deploy migrates on a temporary machine of the serving app, which has the deployment description paths in its settings but may not have the files. It fails while the migration boot read the Base description and stopped on missing_file.

tests.test_name: the serving boot connects with the serving login when the app also holds the release login
tests.keep_because: The serving app holds both logins once the deploy runs the migrations, and the web boot must still connect with the serving login. It fails while the web boot refused any app holding DATABASE_DIRECT_URL.

tests.test_name: outbound TLS trusts exactly castore's list, without the dropped eMudhra roots
tests.keep_because: Every outbound connection must trust castore's list, which dropped the eMudhra roots compromised on 20 Oct 2026; the image's Debian list still holds them. It fails when the application stops loading castore's list at start.

tests.test_name: the counts give each launch type's live and graduated auctions on each chain
tests.keep_because: An outside tracker reads one count instead of paging the list. It fails if a launch type or chain is counted under another, or a failed, opening-soon or other-chain auction is counted.

tests.test_name: a token's price and market cap read in REGENT and in dollars, list and detail alike
tests.keep_because: The token API gives the figures the token list shows, at 18 significant digits, list and detail alike. It fails if a dollar figure uses another rate, or a price comes back with its stored 30-plus decimals.

tests.test_name: a stated price keeps at most 18 significant digits and is the stored one rounded up
tests.keep_because: Property: for any stored price, tiny to huge, the API's price keeps at most 18 significant digits and is the stored price rounded up to them: never below it, and less than one unit of its 18th digit above it.

tests.test_name: each auction and token page links its own API record and describes it
tests.keep_because: An agent on an auction or token page follows the page's JSON link to the same record. It fails if the link is missing, names another record, or the page's structured data is the site's instead of the auction's or token's.

tests.test_name: the public reads allow any origin, and no signed or account route does
tests.keep_because: Another website's page may read the six cookie-free public reads, never with credentials. It fails if a signed-in person's, a profile, a paired agent's or the bid estimate route allows another origin, or a public read stops allowing it.

tests.test_name: every public document names only the one regents-cli release
tests.keep_because: Every agent guide and Markdown page names the single regents-cli release the guides were checked against. It fails when any document names another version or leaves a placeholder unfilled.

tests.test_name: the signed agent guide states the prelaunch gate as this deployment has it
tests.keep_because: agents.md says whether draft saves are open from the deployment's own setting. It fails if the line is fixed text again.

tests.test_name: the short index leads to the whole guide, which carries every tool
tests.keep_because: The short /llms.txt links /llms-full.txt and /sitemap.md, and the whole guide still names every manifest tool. It fails if the index grows back into the whole guide or a tool drops out of it.

tests.test_name: a creator with a checked X account is named by it in the list and on both pages
tests.keep_because: The auctions and tokens lists and the auction and token pages name a creator by their checked X account. It fails if any of them falls back to the wallet while an account is checked.

tests.test_name: a creator with no checked account is named by the short launching wallet
tests.keep_because: Without a checked account the creator is the short wallet, never the full one, on the list and the auction page.

tests.test_name: the creator, price and market figures come before the trade widget
tests.keep_because: A token page opens on its creator, price and market figures before the trade widget, in page order, so a phone shows them first, and never says the chart is unavailable. It fails if the widget moves ahead of the figures or the old button text returns.

tests.test_name: every listed stock opens its own page, which the sitemap lists
tests.keep_because: Each stock on the short list opens a page that answers and is in the sitemap, and the list no longer carries every stock's details. It fails if a stock has no page, a page is missing from the sitemap, or the details move back into the list.

tests.test_name: a symbol is read in any case, and one the listing does not hold is not found
tests.keep_because: A shared stock address works in any case, and an unknown symbol is the 404 page.

tests.test_name: Coming next names the auctions open now, the soonest first
tests.keep_because: The home page offers both ways in and lists the auctions a visitor can join now. It fails if a finished auction shows there while one is open, or a way in goes missing.

tests.test_name: with nothing open, Coming next says so and the finished auction stays in the list
tests.keep_because: With no auction open, Coming next says no auction is taking bids and leaves the finished one out, while the list below still shows it. It fails if the note goes missing, or a finished auction shows in Coming next or drops out of the list.

tests.test_name: the tools agents see open from the footer and the developer guide
tests.keep_because: The Agent Tools button is in the footer and on /docs, not at the top of every page.

tests.test_name: a Revstake token's pass records its splitter's revenue with its trades
tests.keep_because: The token pass reads the splitter's RevenueRecognized logs over its own blocks and records each payment's asset, amount and stakers' share once. It fails if a payment is missed, mis-decoded, or read again by the next pass.

tests.test_name: a Revstake token gives its revenue history, newest first; a Memestock token has none
tests.keep_because: The token API gives a Revstake token's recorded revenue newest first with a transaction link, and null for a Memestock token.

tests.test_name: an agent fills a whole Revstake draft, picture and treasury included, and each field is named
tests.keep_because: A paired agent can set every field of the Revstake create form, its picture and treasury included, and each one it set is named for the person's review. It fails if a field is dropped or saved unnamed.

tests.test_name: the person's own edits leave the agent's list; their EOA acknowledgement is never the agent's
tests.keep_because: The person's edits take a field off the agent's list, an agent can never send the EOA acknowledgement, an agent's treasury change takes the person's acknowledgement back, and any other field or shape refuses the whole save.

tests.test_name: an agent fills a Memestock draft's chain and stock, and only a stock the chain lists
tests.keep_because: A Memestock draft takes its chain and a listed stock from an agent, never an unlisted stock or a treasury.

tests.test_name: the create page names what the agent set, and forgets a field the person changes
tests.keep_because: Before any wallet step the create page shows every field the agent set with its value, and a field the person edits leaves that list.

tests.test_name: the launch review names every agent-set field and shows the community links
tests.keep_because: The launch review, built from the draft as it stands at the press, names the agent's fields and shows every community link, so an agent's save after the page opened cannot reach the wallet step unseen (security review, 21 Oct 2026).

tests.test_name: a Revstake launch's payment review comes from its own record and the real reader
tests.keep_because: The payment card reads the launch's token, splitter, receiver and treasury from the strategy's record and every balance and allowance through the production Base reader, then builds the approval and the payment. It fails if the card goes back to a stored subject or the reader misreads a binding.

tests.test_name: a receiver whose money goes anywhere but the launch's treasury is refused
tests.keep_because: A receiver whose beneficiary is not the launch's treasury is never reviewed.

tests.test_name: a deployment on another network refuses a Base launch's payment review
tests.keep_because: A review is sent on the deployment's network, so it is built only for a launch on that network (the A02 to-do).

tests.test_name: a refresh brings an auction's next activity read forward, never back
tests.keep_because: A confirmed press must bring each listed auction's next activity read on that chain forward from five minutes to the ten-second gap, so a bid shows within seconds, and must never push back a read already due sooner, so presses that keep coming cannot starve it. The case fails if the waiting read stays put, moves for another chain's press, or a sooner read is moved later.

tests.test_name: a refresh on a chain with a Base launchpad runs its discovery at once
tests.keep_because: Once launches are open, a creator's Revstake or Memestock launch press must queue discovery at once instead of waiting for the five-minute schedule, and nothing is queued while the site is read-only or for another chain. The case fails if discovery is not queued, or is queued when it must not be.

tests.test_name: a request is timed by its route pattern and a query by its whole time
tests.keep_because: Every site's dashboard reads request and query time under these names, so a renamed or missing measurement would leave the dashboard blank without any page failing.

tests.test_name: AGENT_SAVE_SHOWS_LIVE: an open create page shows an agent's save without a reload
tests.keep_because: An agent can fill in a draft while the person has the create page open; the box naming what the agent set must show it then, on both create pages, so nothing an agent chose reaches a wallet step unseen. It fails when either page stops hearing of an agent's save.

tests.test_name: MAIN_WALLET_STAYS_OWN: the person's own wallet stays main after Privy makes the Regents wallet
tests.keep_because: Privy makes the Regents wallet during a sign-in, after the person's own wallet; the account's main wallet must stay the person's own. It fails when the shared Privy library or this site's sign-in goes back to taking the most recently verified wallet.

tests.test_name: signed in, a wallet app left from before is never the account's wallet
tests.keep_because: A wallet app left connected from before a sign-in (one used ahead of a Google sign-in, say) must never act for the signed-in account. It fails when Privy's remembered selection is taken without checking it is linked to the account.

tests.test_name: AGENT_TREASURY_NEEDS_TICK: an agent's Safe or smart contract treasury launches only after the person ticks it
tests.keep_because: A Safe or smart contract account a paired agent chose as the treasury receives all its treasury funds, so the launch review is refused until the person ticks it on the create page, and a tick for an address the agent has since changed confirms nothing. It fails when the review stops asking for the tick for either kind or a stale tick is accepted.

tests.test_name: an event keeps only fitting where and outcome values
tests.keep_because: Production log lines are read by Fly and kept; a header, browser report or event field copied in as sent could put an account, a private path or free text into them. Fails if any where or outcome outside the site's own patterns is written as sent instead of as other.

tests.test_name: a request's surface, tool and visit come only from fitting headers
tests.keep_because: Production log lines are read by Fly and kept; a header, browser report or event field copied in as sent could put an account, a private path or free text into them. Fails if a caller's x-regent-client or x-regent-visit header reaches a line without matching the site's own shapes.

tests.test_name: a page's own script calling the API belongs to its visit, by header or cookie
tests.keep_because: A visit is replayed only from its own lines; an API call the page's own script makes would otherwise be written as an outside agent's with no visit, and a call from outside a page must never borrow one. Fails if an /api call carrying the visit in x-regent-visit or the _visit cookie is not the page's, or one carrying neither is given a visit.

tests.test_name: the browser's reports keep only the lines a page can send, twenty at most
tests.keep_because: Production log lines are read by Fly and kept; a header, browser report or event field copied in as sent could put an account, a private path or free text into them. Fails if POST /visit-log writes a name, place or outcome the page cannot send, or more than twenty lines a post.

tests.test_name: a page's own path is written as its route, and a page the site lacks as unmatched
tests.keep_because: Production log lines are read by Fly and kept; a header, browser report or event field copied in as sent could put an account, a private path or free text into them. Fails if a page error names its own path, such as a bid's number, rather than the page's route.

tests.test_name: a missing required value raises Ash's error, and a present one comes back
tests.keep_because: Every site on the shared database calls the one ash_required in public; version 6 there cannot find ash_raise_error, so a missing required value fails with "function does not exist" instead of Ash's error, and a shared library's first migration can put version 6 back on a fresh database. Fails if public.ash_required is not version 7 after every migration has run.

tests.test_name: a page address with a slash at the end is the site's not-found page
tests.keep_because: Fails if any page address ending in a slash answers 200 (a second address for the page) or crashes with 500, as /docs/ did on the live site on 27 Oct.

tests.test_name: an API address with a slash at the end is the API's not-found answer
tests.keep_because: Fails if an /api address ending in a slash answers anything but the API's own not_found JSON, so agents always get the error shape they read.

tests.test_name: the homepage keeps its slash
tests.keep_because: Fails if the slash rule also refuses the homepage, whose address is the slash itself.

tests.test_name: AGENT_CHECK_IN_NAMES_THE_SHARED_ACCOUNT: a paired agent is told it is paired and checks in
tests.keep_because: An agent hears its status from whoami (not_paired, then paired with this site's allowed list and no next step) and its check-in names its person's shared Regent account. It fails without this site's allowed list, where every whoami answered 500.

tests.test_name: SIGN_IN_READ_LOST_KEEPS_SIGN_IN: a lost connection is Try again, and signs no one out
tests.keep_because: A sign-in read that answers as a lost connection is the try-again page (503) and a 503 from /auth/session, never signed out; a page whose socket connects then shows Something didn't load with Try again for the same address and query; the same cookie is signed in once the read works. It fails while a failed read is taken for an ended sign-in.

tests.test_name: a connection cut during the sign-in read is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: The case's own connection cut as the account is read is the try-again page, logged as connection_lost by kind and module only. It fails while a failed read is taken for an ended sign-in.

tests.test_name: a sign-in read that fails for any other reason is the plain error page, and signs no one out
tests.keep_because: A sign-in read that fails for a reason other than a lost connection is the plain error page (500), logged by kind and module only, as the site's other reads are; the same cookie is signed in once it reads. It fails while every failure was shown as signed out or as Try again.

tests.test_name: a lost sign-in read is a 503 for the signed-in wallet's positions and share video
tests.keep_because: /api/v1/me/positions and a wallet's share video answer 503 while the sign-in reads as a lost connection, never 401 or a missing video. It fails while a failed read is taken for no sign-in.

tests.test_name: SIGN_IN_READ_LOST_WRITES_NOTHING: a page whose sign-in can't be read makes no code and saves no draft
tests.keep_because: A page that keeps showing its account while its sign-in can't be read makes no pairing code and saves neither a Revstake nor a Memestock draft, saying each could not be made or saved. It fails while those writes ran as the held person with no fresh lease check.

tests.test_name: a sign-in that has ended is still signed out
tests.keep_because: A sign-in past its 30 days still shows Sign in and /auth/session says signed out, never Try again. It passes with or without the read fix and fails against a fix that takes an ended sign-in for a failed read.

tests.test_name: WALLETS_UNREAD_SAY_TRY_AGAIN: a wallet panel whose wallets can't be read sends nothing and never asks to sign in
tests.keep_because: On the real covered-call page, a Buy ticket whose wallets can't be read because the connection was lost hands the wallet no review even with the account's own wallet open, its press says to try again, nothing on the page asks the person to sign in, and the page stays signed in. Every wallet panel reads the account through the same step. It fails while a lost read signed the panel out.

tests.test_name: CONNECT_ENS_UNREAD_SAYS_TRY_AGAIN: Connect ENS with an unreadable sign-in says try again
tests.keep_because: Connect ENS with a sign-in that can't be read says That did not go through. Try again in a moment., not that the name doesn't fit. It fails while every failure said Use an ENS name controlled by your signed-in wallet.

tests.test_name: AGENT_PAIRING_WITHOUT_ACCOUNT_IS_NOT_PAIRED: a pairing that names no Regent account is agent_not_paired
tests.keep_because: A pairing that names no Regent account is 403 agent_not_paired from the check-in, whoami and the agent routes, with the hint to pair again with Pair New Agent. It fails while whoami answered person_not_here, the check-in refused with person_not_here and the agent routes said try again, against the one-account rule.

tests.test_name: AGENT_PERSON_UNREAD_IS_503: a person's account that can't be read is account_unavailable
tests.keep_because: A paired person's account that can't be read is 503 account_unavailable from the check-in, whoami and the agent routes. It fails while the check-in and whoami answered 500.

tests.test_name: HELD_TREASURY_TICK_WRITES_NOTHING: a page whose sign-in ended and can't be read confirms no treasury
tests.keep_because: A create page whose sign-in has ended elsewhere, and whose next read of it loses its connection, keeps showing the account but cannot confirm the agent's treasury: the tick runs under the lease read again now. It fails while the tick was written without that read (the review of 61ad213d).

tests.test_name: HELD_PAGE_MAKES_NO_DRAFT: a closed review or an agent's save starts no draft for a held account
tests.keep_because: On both create pages a closed or finished launch review, and on /create an agent's saved draft, start no draft for an account whose sign-in ended and cannot be read: a first draft is made only under the lease read again now, and an agent's save is only read. It fails on each of the three while they created the draft directly.

tests.test_name: WRITE_FAILURE_IS_NOT_A_SIGN_IN_READ: a write that fails under a lease raises as itself
tests.keep_because: A write that raises inside SessionAuthority.transact_lease raises as itself and is not logged as a sign-in read. It fails while the whole transaction was rescued and turned into an error tuple.

tests.test_name: a write behind a fresh check runs only for a lease that reads as current now
tests.keep_because: Session.fresh/2, which the launch treasury check uses because it calls the chain first, runs its write only for a lease that reads as current: a lost read is sign_in_unread, an ended sign-in session_unavailable, no lease session_lease_required.

tests.test_name: a wallet read that fails for any other reason is a real error
tests.keep_because: On the real covered-call page, the Buy ticket's own read of the account that fails for a reason other than a lost connection (42P01, injected at that read only) ends the page with the read-failed error, as a page's read does, instead of holding the wallets as unread. It fails while every failure was shown as unread.

tests.test_name: ENS_NAME_TAKEN_IS_NOT_TRY_AGAIN: a name another account holds is refused for good, not retried
tests.keep_because: Saving an ENS name another account already holds answers name_taken, which Connect ENS words as taken, never as try again. It fails while every failed save was a try-again.

tests.test_name: LEASE_WRITE_ON_A_CUT_CONNECTION_SAYS_TRY_AGAIN: a connection gone before the write begins is a try-again
tests.keep_because: With the case's own connection really cut (pg_terminate_backend) before the write's transaction begins, Session.transact/2 answers sign_in_unread and ConnectEns.record_name/3 try_again, logged once as a lost sign-in lease. It fails while Repo.transaction's raise at the start crashed the page, the pairing, the tick, the ENS save and the launch review.

tests.test_name: IMAGE_UPLOAD_HELD_SAYS_TRY_AGAIN_OR_SIGNS_OUT: a picture saved on a held page
tests.keep_because: On both create pages a token picture whose save loses the sign-in's connection says to try again, not that the file is broken, and one whose sign-in has ended signs the page out. Upload progress reaches the page without its event recheck, so the save's own lease check answers. It fails while every refusal fell through to the broken-file note.

tests.test_name: AGENT_PERSON_READ_FAILED_IS_500: a person's account read that fails for another reason is a real error
tests.keep_because: A paired person's account read that fails for a reason other than a lost connection (42P01) is the plain 500 from the check-in, whoami and the agent routes, not the try-again 503. It fails while every failed read answered 503 account_unavailable.

tests.test_name: PAIRING_MESSAGE_STEPS_ARE_WHERE_IT_SAYS: the steps the pairing message names are in the document it names
tests.keep_because: The pairing message sent agents to "Pair with a person's account" steps at /llms.txt, which had none (found by the agent journeys, 27 Oct 2026). The case follows the message to the document and checks the steps and their commands are there. It fails without them.

tests.test_name: AGENT_SET_ADDRESS_IS_COPYABLE: an address the agent set can be copied whole and opened on Basescan
tests.keep_because: The list of what an agent filled in printed its addresses as bare text, against the rule that every address can be copied whole and opened (found by the agent journeys, 27 Oct 2026). The case checks the agent's treasury copies whole and links Basescan. It fails on the bare text. It also checks a treasury saved part-way shows as written: drawn as an address it crashed the page (found by the adversarial review, 27 Oct 2026).

tests.test_name: PAIRING_CODE_WORKS_ONCE: a code pairs exactly one agent, however many try it, in any order and at once
tests.keep_because: A pairing code is the only thing that ties an agent to a person's account. The property tries one code with one to four agents in every order, one after another and all at once, and checks exactly one pairing is made and every other try is refused as pairing_failed.

tests.test_name: PAIRING_CODE_ENDS_AT_TEN_MINUTES: a code well under ten minutes old pairs, and one well past them does not
tests.keep_because: A code that outlives ten minutes lets a pasted message pair an agent long after the person stopped watching. The property moves a fresh code's clock back by up to twenty minutes, never within half a minute of the edge since the pairing reads the clock itself a moment later, and checks it pairs exactly when it is younger than ten minutes.

tests.test_name: PAIRING_CODE_ENDS_AT_TEN_MINUTES: a code is made for exactly ten minutes, and ten minutes on it pairs nobody
tests.keep_because: The exact edge of a code's ten minutes, without racing the clock: a code is made to last exactly ten minutes, and one that turns ten minutes old at a moment read before the request pairs nobody when the pairing reads the clock after it.

tests.test_name: ONLY_OFFERED_HARNESSES_PAIR: an agent pairs exactly when its harness is one this site offers, and never as ChatGPT
tests.keep_because: ChatGPT pairs only through a plugin this site does not serve, so an agent naming it here must be refused before its code is spent. The property sends every known harness and made-up ones and checks only the site's offered list pairs.

tests.test_name: PAIR_TAKES_EXACTLY_CODE_NAME_AND_HARNESS: a pair request with any other set of fields spends nothing and is refused
tests.keep_because: A pair request carrying a missing or extra field must spend nothing. The property sends every other set of fields and checks each is pairing_failed and the same code still pairs afterwards.

tests.test_name: AGENT_LIMIT_IS_ONE_HUNDRED
tests.keep_because: One account holds at most a hundred agents. The case pairs a hundred and checks the next is refused as agent_limit.

tests.test_name: AN_AGENT_ACTS_ONLY_FOR_ITS_OWN_PERSON: every private answer names the account of the agent's current pairing, or refuses
tests.keep_because: The worst thing an agent route can do is answer for someone else's account. The property runs random pairings, unpairings and check-ins across three people and four agents and checks every answer names the account of the agent's current pairing, or is agent_not_paired.

tests.test_name: REVIEW_SIGNS_ONLY_WHAT_WAS_REVIEWED: the launch step decodes back to exactly the reviewed draft
tests.keep_because: The person's wallet signs the review's launch step, so that step must carry exactly the draft they reviewed. The property encodes random drafts at every byte limit, decodes the step with the launchpad's own ABI and checks every field comes back unchanged.

tests.test_name: AGENT_ROUTES_ANSWER_AS_THE_CONTRACT_SAYS: whoami, check-in and pairing answer only what the contract documents
tests.keep_because: The served contract, which the regents command line copies, said check-in refused with 404 and pairing with 403 or 422; the routes answer 403 agent_not_paired, 400 pairing_failed or harness_unknown or invalid_name, and 409 agent_limit, and whoami answers an unpaired agent 200 not_paired (found by the lead chief's review, 28 Oct 2026). The case drives each route through the real plugs and checks the contract documents the status and code it got. It fails on the old contract.

tests.test_name: SETTLE_PRESS_BEFORE_REVIEW_SENDS: a settlement press with no review on the card is prepared and sent
tests.keep_because: A settlement card's button names its action before its review arrives, and a press in that moment sent nothing (found by the agent journeys, 28 Oct 2026). The case presses before the card has its review and checks the card prepares it and hands back its exit step. It fails without the card's prepare_and_send.

tests.test_name: a press with no review yet asks the server for one when the card prepares on press
tests.keep_because: The page half of the same defect: a press on a card with no review inputs and no review sent nothing. The cases check such a card asks the server first, and that every other card behaves as before. They fail without asksServer.

tests.test_name: PAIRING_CODE_KEPT_PER_AGENT
tests.keep_because: The pairing box made a new code on every agent choice, so choosing one agent, then another, then the first again showed a third code and the message already pasted to the first agent no longer matched the screen (27 Oct 2026). The case fails if coming back to an agent shows a different code while its code is still in time, or if "Make a new code" for one agent changes another agent's code.

tests.test_name: CHAIN_LAUNCH_SHOWS_ONLY_WHAT_PASSES: text, website and picture are kept only as a page may show them
tests.keep_because: Every Memestock launch on Base is listed, including ones made outside the site, whose text, website and picture no create page checked. For any bytes a launch can carry, the site keeps only text with nothing hidden in it, a full https:// website with no space in it and a picture it stores.

tests.test_name: a launch made outside the site is listed under the wallet that sent it, with only what passes the site's checks
tests.keep_because: Sean's choice (28 Oct 2026, list everything): a launch sent straight to the launchpad, as an agent sends one from its own wallet, is listed under that wallet with no account, on the public lists and its own page, with invalid bytes, hidden characters, an unsafe link and an outside picture removed, and an operator can still hide it.

tests.test_name: a launch the site cannot list yet waits, and is listed once it can
tests.keep_because: Found by the second review: a launch an earlier pass left unlisted that the chain or the stock list could not answer for yet stayed unlisted and was never taken again. It now waits as pending and is listed once it can be.

tests.test_name: the two test launches the operator hid are never listed
tests.keep_because: Sean, 29 Oct 2026, "Hide both": the release's data change marks Base Memestock launches 1 and 2 (V2 AUTOLAUNCH TEST) hidden, and no resolve pass lists them afterwards, while launch 3 is untouched.

tests.test_name: L9: an agent launches from its own wallet, owns the launch, is paid its creator share, and the site lists it under that wallet
tests.keep_because: End to end on the Base copy: the launchpad records the agent's wallet as creator, the creator allocation and the creator's fee share pay that wallet, and the site's own discovery lists the launch under it.

tests.test_name: ACCOUNT_MENU_ON_EVERY_PAGE
tests.keep_because: The account menu is the only way to Pair New Agent from any page. The case fails if a LiveView page or a page served without LiveView lacks the menu, if the menu lists the oldest of four agents or more than three, if its Pair New Agent does not open the pairing window (#shell-pairing), if the window on a page served without LiveView cannot make a code, if the Agents page's Pair New Agent does not open the same window or the page holds a second pairing box, or if the Account page puts this site's sections after the shared ones.

tests.test_name: the menu shows the three most recently active agents
tests.keep_because: Whatever the readings, the menu shows at most three agents, none left out more recently active than one shown, every active one before the rest, and the rest newest paired first.

tests.test_name: the listeners share a connection to the direct address with the serving login
tests.keep_because: The shared agent listeners need one connection with connection keys (never a URL) on the direct address with the serving login; a pooled address drops LISTEN and the account menu and pages stop hearing agent changes.

tests.test_name: every agent kind draws its picture
tests.keep_because: Pairings are shared across Regent sites, so an agent paired anywhere shows in every site's account menu and Account page; an agent kind without a picture in the design system raised wherever the person's agents were drawn.

tests.test_name: MARKET_TICKER_BEHIND_MENU
tests.keep_because: The bar along the bottom must be marked as part of what the open phone menu makes inert; it draws only with bids or trades to show, so a missing mark stays hidden until a person finds a pressable bar beside the open menu.

tests.test_name: the health answer runs under the strict policy
tests.keep_because: Every answer must carry the strict policy, nosniff and referrer-policy, including answers given before the router and pages that do not exist; a gap shows only on addresses no page test opens, and Sentinel's same-check reads them.

tests.test_name: a page that does not exist runs under the strict policy
tests.keep_because: Every answer must carry the strict policy, nosniff and referrer-policy, including answers given before the router and pages that do not exist; a gap shows only on addresses no page test opens, and Sentinel's same-check reads them.

tests.test_name: PAIR_LINK_STAYS_ON_SITE
tests.keep_because: A pairing link's page is printed in the message a person pastes to their agent. The case fails if /pair takes anything but a page on this site, such as //example.com, /\example.com, another site's address, a script address, a page with spaces or control characters, or one over 512 characters, so an agent is never sent elsewhere.

tests.test_name: the first render carries the person's figures, open actions and place
tests.keep_because: The Points page's first render already shows the person's total, today's points, their place, every action by its site, done or still open with where to do it, and their own row marked on the leaderboard; nothing waits on a second read.

tests.test_name: two people with one name, level on points, each keep their own picture
tests.keep_because: Names are not unique and many people share a place: two people with one name at one place each keep their own picture on the leaderboard.

tests.test_name: a person with no name shows by their wallet, with its copy icon
tests.keep_because: Another person with no name shows by their public wallet with its copy icon, and nothing else about their account, such as their Privy id, reaches the page.

tests.test_name: a paired agent is answered with the page's figures
tests.keep_because: A paired agent's Points answer carries the same total, place, actions by site and leaderboard the page shows, each leaderboard row with only its place, name or wallet and total.

tests.test_name: a signed-out visitor is asked to sign in and gets nothing from the board
tests.keep_because: A signed-out visitor is asked to sign in and gets no name, wallet or total from the leaderboard held for signed-in readers.

tests.test_name: while the board is not read, the agent's whole answer is unavailable
tests.keep_because: While the shared leaderboard is not read, a paired agent's Points answer is 503 account_unavailable rather than half an answer.

tests.test_name: every reading offered reports its size against its kind's limit, refused ones too
tests.keep_because: Every reading offered to the shared figures reports its size against its kind's limit, refused ones too, so the leaderboard growing towards its limit shows before it is refused.

tests.test_name: a pool read again keeps its line and shows no placeholder
tests.keep_because: After every trade the token page reads its pool again; the reading placeholder once showed above the live chart until the read came back, pushing the page down. The case fails if a read again shows the placeholder or drops the line.

tests.test_name: read in the same second the pool opened, there is a line by trade and none by time
tests.keep_because: A line by time read before any time has passed puts all 100 points at one spot, so the chart drew only a dot; it is left out until time passes and the chart offers no Time choice. The case fails if a read in the opening second gives a line by time.

tests.test_name: binds to a wallet the leased account links and refuses anything else, in order
tests.keep_because: Every wallet review (Revstake launches, bids, settlements, swaps, Stocks and Robinhood) binds to the signed-in account's own wallet through one shared check. A missing person, a malformed address, a missing lease, another account's actor or an unlinked wallet is refused, in that order, with the same reasons the pages show and naming the record the action reviews.

tests.test_name: a node answering behind the saved cursor waits and keeps the saved history
tests.keep_because: A node whose head is behind the saved cursor is a lagging node, not a reorg; it once deleted an auction's whole saved bid history and rebuilt it from the first block. The case fails if such a pass clears the cursor, the bids or the price points instead of waiting a minute.

tests.test_name: a different block at the saved cursor still clears the history to rebuild it
tests.keep_because: A real reorg, a different block at the last block read, must still clear the auction's derived history and rebuild it. The case fails if a changed block at the cursor leaves the old bids or cursor in place.

tests.test_name: a pass that has not reached the head leaves the totals as stored
tests.keep_because: A pass still catching up once wrote the bid totals blank and back every ten minutes for a finished auction, waking every list page twice. The case fails if a pass that stops short of the head changes the stored token or dollar bid total.

tests.test_name: a pass that reached the head with no dollar rate blanks the dollar total
tests.keep_because: A caught-up pass with no dollar price for the auction's currency kept the old dollar total beside a new token total, so the lists showed figures that disagree. The case fails if that pass keeps the old dollar total or does not write the new token total.

tests.test_name: a returned or claimed bid is not read from the chain again
tests.keep_because: A returned or claimed bid never changes on chain again, so the ended-auction pass does not read it again. The case fails if a finished bid is among the positions read, or an unfinished one is left out.

tests.test_name: a bid whose answer is bad is skipped and the bids after it are still read
tests.keep_because: One bid whose answer is malformed once stopped every later bid of the auction from being read, on every pass. The case fails if a bad answer for one bid stops the bids after it.

tests.test_name: a node that stops answering ends the bid reads, keeping those already read
tests.keep_because: When the node stops answering, the pass stops asking and keeps the bids it already read for writing. The case fails if the pass goes on asking after the node stopped answering, or drops the readings it had.

tests.test_name: a bid receipt checked again after the bid settled leaves its standing and amounts
tests.keep_because: The page's bid receipt once wrote the bid back to active with blank settlement amounts when checked after the bid had been exited and claimed. The case fails if a repeated receipt changes a settled bid's status, times or amounts.

tests.test_name: an auction an operator hid is in no count, as it is in no list
tests.keep_because: The public live and graduated counts must match the public lists, which leave out auctions an operator hid. The case fails if a hidden auction is counted.

tests.test_name: a database with every migration applied says so
tests.keep_because: Rollout of 12 Nov 2026 (pin, confirm window, pairing window, health field): the release check reads migrations_applied on the live site. The case fails if the answer stops saying whether this release's migrations are applied, or stops answering 200 while one is pending.

tests.test_name: a migration the database has not recorded leaves the answer at 200 and says so
tests.keep_because: Rollout of 12 Nov 2026 (pin, confirm window, pairing window, health field): the release check reads migrations_applied on the live site. The case fails if the answer stops saying whether this release's migrations are applied, or stops answering 200 while one is pending.

tests.test_name: FINISH_PRESS_BEFORE_READING_SENDS: a Finish press with no reading on the card is read and sent
tests.keep_because: The Finish card's button names the finish before the card has read the launch, and a press in that moment sent nothing, so the auction stayed ended (the agent journeys on a busy machine, 12 Nov 2026). The case presses before the card has a reading and checks the card reads the launch and hands back the strategy's migrate for the pressing wallet. It fails without the card's prepare_and_send.

tests.test_name: a Finish press on a launch the chain shows finished sends nothing
tests.keep_because: The press that is read on the spot must still send nothing when the chain says the finish is certain to fail. The case fails if a press on a finished launch hands the wallet a transaction.

tests.test_name: DISCOVERY_SKIPS_ONE_UNREADABLE_LAUNCH: listing discovery records the launches around one the chain will not answer for
tests.keep_because: Audit finding B8 (12 Nov 2026): one launch the chain would not answer for stopped discovery of every launch after it and of the other launchpad in the same run. The case fails if the launches around it are not recorded, if the run does not fail so it is tried again, if the count stops showing the site behind, or if the one left out is not recorded once the chain answers.

tests.test_name: the finisher's discovery records the launches around one the chain will not answer for
tests.keep_because: Audit finding B8 (12 Nov 2026), for the launches the finisher knows of: an ended auction after an unreadable launch was never finished by the operator. The case fails if the launches around the unreadable one are not recorded, or if it is not recorded on a later run.

tests.test_name: is a tick the auction holds below the price, the one just below it when in reach
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A2 (12 Nov 2026): a new bid's tick hint walked the auction's tick list and gave up after 256 steps. Property case over lists of any length: the hint is always a tick the auction holds below the bid's price, and the one just below it when the walk reaches it. It fails if a hint above the price or not in the list is ever given.

tests.test_name: is refused when the floor is not below the price or the list does not climb
tests.keep_because: A tick list that does not climb, or a floor at or above the price, has no valid hint; the walk says so instead of handing back a tick the auction would refuse. It fails if such a list yields a hint.

tests.test_name: a read that fails is the read's own answer
tests.keep_because: A tick read that fails ends the walk with that failure, so the bid card says the chain could not be read just now instead of building a bid from a partial walk. It fails if a failed read becomes a hint.

tests.test_name: is the exact crossing within the stated reads in each request, and a looser one goes on from it
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A1 (12 Nov 2026) and its review: a settlement's checkpoint hints walked from the bid and gave up after 256 steps, stranding a bid in a busy auction, and the outbid walk then read the same stretch again from the bid. Property case: for crossings anywhere along any history, the last fully filled and the outbid hints are the exact ones, the outbid walk going on from where the first ended, and each request reads at most 2*ceil(log2(n + 1)) + 257 entries. It fails on a wrong crossing, a read count over the bound, or an outbid walk that starts again from the bid.

tests.test_name: a long stretch no bid wrote is read across requests, each going on from the last
tests.keep_because: A stretch of checkpoints longer than one request's reads is walked across requests, each going on from where the last one stopped, until the crossing is found. It fails if a request starts over or never reaches the crossing.

tests.test_name: a bid whose own checkpoint does not pass has no crossing to give
tests.keep_because: A bid still fully in the auction has no crossing; the walk says so instead of inventing hints. It fails if such a bid gets settlement hints.

tests.test_name: a read that fails is the read's own answer, and keeps where the walk reached
tests.keep_because: A checkpoint read that fails answers that failure and keeps where the walk had reached, so the next request goes on from there. It fails if a failed read becomes hints or the walk's progress is lost.

tests.test_name: a bid in a busy auction names the tick just below its price, however many lie below
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A2 against the Base bid reader: an auction holding hundreds of ticks below a bid's price refused the bid before; now the bid names the tick just below its price. It fails if the 256-step limit comes back. Since 18 Nov 2026 it also proves every read of the snapshot is pinned to the latest block's hash, the block it names.

tests.test_name: a bid further up than one walk reaches names the highest tick the walk reached
tests.keep_because: A bid whose price lies beyond one walk's reads still gets a tick the auction holds below its price, the highest the walk reached, which the auction accepts and walks on from. It fails if such a bid is refused.

tests.test_name: a partly filled bid hundreds of checkpoints from its crossing is settled with the exact hints
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A1 against the Base settlement reader: a partly filled bid hundreds of checkpoints from its crossing could not be withdrawn or claimed before; now its settlement carries the exact hints. It fails if the 256-step limit comes back.

tests.test_name: a stretch longer than one request's reads is read across requests, and the outbid walk goes on from the filled one
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A1 and its review (12 Nov 2026): a crossing further than one request's reads is reached over several requests through the kept walk, then the outbid walk goes on from the last fully filled checkpoint instead of reading the stretch again, so the review settles on the second request. It fails if the reader starts over, never settles, or walks the stretch twice.

tests.test_name: a shown amount reads back as the exact raw amount
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A6 (12 Nov 2026): raw amounts were formatted with 28-digit decimal precision and shown rounded under a wallet review. Property case: every shown amount up to 2^256-1 at 0 to 36 decimals reads back to the exact raw integer. It fails on any rounding.

tests.test_name: the largest uint256 amounts are shown digit for digit
tests.keep_because: The largest raw amount the chain can hold is shown digit for digit at 18 and at 0 decimals, and small amounts without trailing zeros. It fails if a large amount is rounded or shortened.

tests.test_name: a return that did not go through is prepared again from the auction as it is now
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A5 (12 Nov 2026): a withdraw or claim that reverted kept its review, so the next press sent the same transaction again. The card says it did not go through and reads the settlement again from the auction. It fails if the old review is sent again.

tests.test_name: a return that did not go through after the bid was returned another way gives the auction's answer
tests.keep_because: When the bid was returned another way meanwhile, the card says the step did not go through, gives the auction's own answer and holds no review to send. It fails if the stale step is offered again.

tests.test_name: the Revstake create page reads the pause again each time the site reads a new Base block
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A13 (12 Nov 2026): the create page read whether launches were paused once, as it connected, so a disabled launch button stayed disabled after launches reopened. Each time the site's shared reader reads a new Base block (every five minutes on mainnet, every second on a lab, and soon after an on-chain press lands), the page reads the factory again; the button and its line follow the latest read both ways. It fails if the page keeps its first reading.

tests.test_name: the Memestock create page reads the launchpad's pause again each time the site reads a new block
tests.keep_because: The same for Memestock: each time the site reads a new block on the stocks feed (every five minutes on mainnet), the page reads the launchpad's launchesPaused() at the latest block, and the button comes back with the first read that finds launches open. It fails if the page keeps its first reading.

tests.test_name: the home list offers the return of a bid from a second linked wallet
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A7 (12 Nov 2026): lists read only the signed-in wallet's bids, so a bid from another linked wallet had no Withdraw or Claim. It fails if the home list leaves out a linked wallet's bid.

tests.test_name: its card is prepared for the wallet that is open, and names the wallet it pays
tests.keep_because: Review of audit finding A7 (12 Nov 2026), rule 11: the auction takes a return or a claim from any sender and pays the bid's owner, yet the card asked the person to switch wallets. The card prepares the step for the wallet that is open and names the bid's own wallet as the one paid. It fails if the press is blocked for another of the account's wallets, or the paid wallet is not named.

tests.test_name: the portfolio lists it with its button
tests.keep_because: The portfolio lists a linked wallet's bid with its button. It fails if the portfolio reads only the signed-in wallet.

tests.test_name: a press with no review on the row is prepared and sent
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A12 (12 Nov 2026): a Robinhood withdraw or claim pressed before its review arrived sent nothing. The row now prepares the settlement for the pressing wallet and hands back its first step. It fails without the row's prepare_and_send.

tests.test_name: a settlement Robinhood could not read keeps its button, and the next press asks again
tests.keep_because: After a read Robinhood could not answer, the row kept no button, so a later press could not ask again. The button stays and the next press reads the auction again. It fails if the button disappears or the press sends nothing.

tests.test_name: the public answer gives the stored report's own verification
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A14 (12 Nov 2026): the treasury answer gave every report a fixed awaiting state. It now gives the stored report's own verification_state and verification_reason, verified for a 2-of-3 Safe and unverified with its reason otherwise. It fails if the answer stops following the stored report.

tests.test_name: the launch card shows a verified Safe as verified
tests.keep_because: The launch card said no launch could be prepared for any report not made in that visit, even a verified Safe. It now shows a stored verified report as verified. It fails if a verified Safe is shown as unverified.

tests.test_name: sends the review the page holds while the connection is down, and before the server that took over answers
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A3 and its review (12 Nov 2026), rule 11: a press always reaches the wallet, and a duplicate or reverted transaction is an accepted outcome. While the connection is down, and after it is back until the new server's review arrives, a press sends the review the page holds. It fails if such a press sends nothing.

tests.test_name: asks the server that took over for a fresh review as the page rejoins, and sends the one it pushes
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A3 (12 Nov 2026): as the page rejoins, the server that took over hears the wallet Privy has active and pushes a fresh review, which a press then sends. It fails if the rejoin does not ask, or the fresh review is ignored.

tests.test_name: a step of the open review that reverted builds the review again
tests.keep_because: Audit finding A5 (12 Nov 2026): a reverted step left its review on the page, so the next press sent the same failed transaction. The panel's review is built again from the chain. It fails if the old review stays.

tests.test_name: while another step of that review is on its way, the review waits for it
tests.keep_because: A review is not built again while another step sent from it is still on its way, so that step's outcome is not lost, and the person is still told the reverted step did not go through. It fails if the review is replaced under a step in flight.

tests.test_name: a step from a review the page has left changes nothing
tests.keep_because: A revert reported for a review the page has already replaced changes nothing on the panel. It fails if a stale revert throws away the current review.

tests.test_name: the words go beside a review built again, or before the reason nothing was built
tests.keep_because: The panel says the step did not go through beside the new review, or before the chain's reason when the action is refused now. It fails if the person is not told, or the refusal reason is lost.

tests.test_name: another account's bid is never listed, and its settlement is refused
tests.keep_because: Review of audit finding A7 (12 Nov 2026): the lists read every wallet an account links, and nothing proved they stop there. A bid of another account's wallet is on neither the home list nor the portfolio, and preparing its settlement from any of the account's wallets is refused. It fails if another account's bid is shown or can be settled.

tests.test_name: a bid of another wallet the account links is prepared for the open one and read for its own
tests.keep_because: Review of audit finding A7 (12 Nov 2026): a Base bid's return is prepared for any wallet the account links, and its receipt is read against the bid's own wallet, which the auction pays. It fails if only the bid's wallet may prepare it, or a receipt naming another owner counts.

tests.test_name: a bid of another wallet the account links is prepared for the open one, which the row names
tests.keep_because: Review of audit finding A7 (12 Nov 2026): on Robinhood too the auction pays the bid's owner whoever sends, so the row prepares the return for the open wallet and names the bid's own wallet, while an account that does not link the bid's wallet is refused. It fails if the press is blocked for another of the account's wallets, or another account can prepare it.

tests.test_name: a request from a node behind the others leaves where the walk reached as it is
tests.keep_because: Review of audit finding A1 (12 Nov 2026): a request pinned to a block before the checkpoint a walk had reached, from a node behind the others, could not read it and the walk forgot it, so the next request read the whole stretch again. Such a request now walks from the bid and leaves what is kept. It fails if a lagging read erases or uses the kept progress.

tests.test_name: a report stored before 9 Nov answers a reason the published contract lists
tests.keep_because: Review of audit finding A14 (12 Nov 2026): treasury reports written before 9 Nov can carry the reason configuration_changed, which the published API contract left out, so a client checking the list would refuse such an answer. The served contract lists it. It fails if the public answer can give a reason the contract does not list.

tests.test_name: an auction whose window was never read opens while Robinhood's clock is known
tests.keep_because: Review of the money-path fixes (12 Nov 2026): a Robinhood auction page drew its bid timeline from the auction's start and end blocks, and for an auction whose window was not read yet it crashed as soon as the site knew Robinhood's clock; two tests had cleared the clock to avoid it. The page opens and leaves the timeline out until the window is read. It fails if the page crashes or draws a timeline with no window.

tests.test_name: a bid estimate is the amount over the price, exact to the token's last unit
